steps.instruction: On the Kanboard 'Bench Board' project board, create a new task with the title exactly '{{runid}} Bench Task' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench task created for run {{runid}}'). Use the board's 'Add a new task' / new task form; fill any required fields (leave the column as the default first column, do not set a due date yet). Submit the form and verify the task was created. Report the task's numeric ID as Kanboard displays it (the #<number> shown on the task card or task page) and the task title. Do not modify any tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:'.

steps.instruction: On the Kanboard task page for task {{02-create.task_id_as_displayed}} ('{{runid}} Bench Task') in the Bench Board project, do two things: (1) add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment added for run {{runid}}'), using the task page's comment form, and verify the comment appears on the task page; (2) set the task's due date to 2026-12-31 (use the task page's edit/details form or the due-date field; Kanboard may expect the date format MM/DD/YYYY, i.e. 12/31/2026 — enter it in whatever format the form accepts and confirm it saves as December 31, 2026). Verify afterwards on the task page that the due date is displayed as 12/31/2026 and that the comment text is visible. Report the exact due date text shown and the exact comment text shown. Do not modify any tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:'.
